title: Austin ISD's fall calendar
subtitle: The Webb and Burnet petitions and the school board election
alt: Timeline from Austin Current and KXAN: parent petitions to close Webb and Burnet middle schools were due October 15; on October 19 the Texas Education Agency confirmed it received a complaint from the Webb Parent-Teacher Association, and early voting opened for five Austin Independent School District board seats; Election Day is November 3; Superintendent Matias Segura has until December 1 to verify the petition signatures.

events.label: Petitions due
events.note: Parents at Webb and Burnet asked the state to close the schools

events.label: TEA confirms Webb PTA complaint
events.note: Early voting opens for five board seats
